title: feat(spec,service-analytics): a dataset answer says which records each measure counted, so a drill lists what the number counted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu6W6tm24ezCZ9jmVrXt12YA)_

domain:spec#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXexAhb1ogpnymn5Jb
Fixes #30526

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据集查询的回答多了一个可选字段 `drillScopes`，按度量说明“这个数字统计的是哪些记录”：数据集自己的筛选，加上度量自己的筛选，再加上被汇总的字段有值。
- 为什么改：点开一个带筛选的数字（例如“已付款发票 2 张”）时，现在的下钻只按分组和组件筛选去列记录，会列出 4 张。客户端读不到数据集和度量的定义，所以只能由服务端在回答里告诉它。
- 风险与回滚：只新增一个可选字段，不读它的客户端不受影响；查询算出的数字不变，唯一的行为改动是日期等占位符改为在查询入口解析一次，算数和下钻范围共用同一个时刻。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `packages/services/service-analytics/src/drill-scope.ts`（什么算范围、什么时候不给）；② `packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` 里提前解析占位符和写 `result.drillScopes` 的两处；③ `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts` 的字段说明。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/dataset-drill-scopes.test.ts`，预期 20 个测试全部通过，其中标着 CONTROL 的一条表明：不带范围时列出 4 条记录，而数字是 2。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The precedent is `drillRanges` (#27074), and before it `dimensionFields` / `drillRawRows` (#20700). Those keys bound the clicked **bucket**. This PR adds the fifth drill sidecar, which bounds the clicked **measure**. It sits on the same answer and follows the same rule (ADR-0021 D2: the server states the drill bounds, and the client never restates dataset semantics).

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `AnalyticsResult.drillScopes`, optional, a map from measure name to `FilterCondition`, declared on the `AnalyticsResultResponse` wire schema too. Each selected measure name maps to the list filter on the answer's `object` that selects the records the measure aggregates. The filter is built from three parts:
  - the dataset's `filter`;
  - AND the measure's `filter`;
  - AND, for a measure over a field, `{ field: { $null: false } }`, or both instants for a duration measure.

  Tokens are resolved as the query resolved them. The value is `{}` when no part applies. A measure is **left out** when no list filter can select its records, and a measure left out offers no drill (the #30080 ruling, option A). That happens in three cases:
  - a derived measure;
  - a scope naming a relationship path (`account.region` as a key, or a dotted `$field`);
  - a filter that is not a condition object.

  A `__compare` column has no entry. `drillScopes` is set on every dataset answer that has rows. It is absent on a cube query answer and on a draft-preview answer.
- **`@objectstack/service-analytics`**: `queryDataset` computes the scope in `drill-scope.ts` (`measureDrillScopes`, a pure function). It takes the token-resolved filters from **before** the dataset door's field binding, because the binding's minted member names are request-local and no record list knows them. `resolveSelectionTokens` is now exported and called once in `answerDataset`. The executor and the scope read the same resolved trees, and the executor's own call is then the identity. `datasetMeasureSource` finds what a measure aggregates the same way the queries did:
  - derived, bare or `CUBE.`-qualified;
  - duration, through `durationMeasureIn`;
  - declared, through `scopedMeasureKey`;
  - caller-minted, through `mintCallerMeasures`.
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`**: `queryDataset` hand-picks the keys it returns, so it dropped any sidecar it did not list. This was measured before the change: the key never reached a widget. It now passes `drillScopes` through, typed as the spec slot.
- Generated: `content/docs/references/api/analytics.mdx` (`gen:docs`, the one artifact `check:generated` proved stale). Ledger: `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains one site; see the Acceptance notes.

### What each consumer must compose (not in this PR: #30080 and the ui card the seat files at landing)

A drill of a clicked number on measure `M` lists `{ $and: [bucket, widgetFilter, drillScopes[M]] }` on `object`, leaving out any part that is absent:

| Consumer | `bucket` | `widgetFilter` | scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| Report drill (`plugin-report` dataset renderer) | `buildDatasetDrillFilter` over `dimensionFields` + `drillRawRows[i]` + `drillRanges[i]` (a totals row: `drillRawTotals[i][j]`) | the report's `runtimeFilter` | `drillScopes[M]` |
| Chart / table widget drill (`plugin-dashboard` `DatasetWidget`) | the same builder for the clicked row and series | the widget's `runtimeFilter` | `drillScopes[M]` of the clicked series |
| Dashboard tile click (#30080) | none (a KPI has no dimensions) | the tile's `runtimeFilter` | `drillScopes[M]` |

If `drillScopes` has no entry for `M`, the consumer offers no click. `{}` means "drillable, nothing to add", which is a different thing from a missing entry.

## Why

A dataset number is computed under the dataset's `filter`, the measure's `filter` and the widget's `runtimeFilter`. A host that drills the number holds only the last one, and it has no read of the dataset definition. So every drill of a filtered measure listed a superset of what the number counted. On the showcase shape, the bucket listed 4 invoices behind `paid_count` 2. #30080 (the dashboard tile click, ruled option A) waits on this answer.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-drill-scopes.test.ts` (new, 20 tests):
  - **Unit tier** (mocked ObjectQL face), on the real producer shape (`examples/app-showcase` revenue-pulse: `paid_count` = count with `filter: { status: 'paid' }`, and `paid_rate` derived). Pins:
    - measure filter only;
    - dataset filter only, and both;
    - count over a field;
    - nested-relation form and a same-record `$field` kept;
    - tokens resolved to the caller, and the engine was handed the same value;
    - a cube-qualified name;
    - a dimensionless KPI carries the scope, and a zero-row answer carries none;
    - the scope is a deep copy;
    - **contract vs wire**: the real service's answer, through `JSON.stringify`, parsed by `AnalyticsResultResponseSchema`, keeps every scope.
  - **Real-engine tier** (ObjectQL + `SqlDriver` on SQLite, both faces, with and without a widget filter). Every count's composed drill (`bucket ∧ widget ∧ scope`) lists as many records as the number, and the sum adds up. Further pins:
    - a CONTROL pin: the bucket alone lists 4 against `paid_count` 2;
    - a duration measure, where the mean over the listed records equals the number;
    - a nested-relation dataset filter;
    - a dotted measure filter and a dotted dataset filter leave the scope out;
    - a CONTROL pin: `engine.find` refuses the dotted key with `INVALID_FIELD`.
- `packages/spec/src/api/analytics.test.ts`: the response schema keeps each scope verbatim. It refuses these malformed values at `data.drillScopes`:
  - a string;
  - a list in an equality slot;
  - `$and` given an object;
  - an array map.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.test.ts`: a typed `drillScopes` read on the contract, plus a `@ts-expect-error` on a string scope.
- `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts`:
  - the passthrough keeps scopes verbatim, `{}` included;
  - absent stays `undefined`;
  - an array, a string or `null` is dropped;
  - a compile-time pin of identity with `AnalyticsResult['drillScopes']`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Shape choices beyond the brief, each deliberate.** Each one is pinned by a test above.
  1. The not-null leg for a measure over a field. Every aggregate skips an empty value (`COUNT(field)`, #10298), so without the leg, `count of total` would list rows whose `total` is empty.
  2. A duration measure requires both instants.
  3. `{}` for a measure with nothing to add, so that "absent" keeps one meaning: no drill.
  4. Tokens are resolved once and shared by the numbers and the scope, so the two cannot straddle a period boundary. The error path is unchanged: every token refusal is a declared 400 that the catch rethrows either way.
  5. A caller-minted (undeclared) measure gets a scope too.
- **Relationship paths.** The nested-relation form (`{ account: { tier: 'gold' } }`) is kept, because the record list serves it. A dotted path is left out, because the list refuses a dotted filter key. A later change could lower a one-hop dotted path to the nested form; this PR does not.
- **Ledger growth, a decision for the seat.** `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains `api/AnalyticsResultResponse` → `data.drillScopes.valueType.lazy`. This is the same `FilterConditionSchema` lazy refinement already admitted at `api/AnalyticsQueryRequest` → `where.lazy`, and the spec build prints this entry. Header totals move 251 → 252 schemas and 1019 → 1020 sites.
- **Found, not fixed here (in the report):**
  - The engine refuses the nested-relation form inside an aggregation's own `filter` ("the nested-relation form, which the engine serves in 'where' only"). So a dataset **measure** whose `filter` is `{ account: { tier: 'gold' } }` fails the whole answer, even though the dataset schema accepts it. This was measured at the service on SQLite, not at the HTTP door.
  - `data-objectstack` also drops `drillRawTotals`. No ui code reads it today, so the gap is not felt.
- **Branch name.** The branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-mg9ioh`, not `claude/issue-30526-*`, as amended on the claim.
- **Attribution link.** It names this card thread, where the brief named the seat thread: the platform writes this thread's own link.
- **New lint warnings.** eslint on `data-objectstack` adds 1 + 3 `no-explicit-any` warnings. These are `(data as any)` and test `as any` casts in the files' existing pattern; there are 0 errors.

## Verification

Head `ba62840b` (branch base `c23eafa8`, `origin/main` `f5aaa0bc` merged in), under `os-verify-lock`, `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`. Every count below is a VERDICT `command-exit 0` unless it says otherwise. Every suite below ran twice, once at `25fc5696` before the merge and once at `ba62840b` after it, with the same counts both times.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14 of 14 artifacts up to date, after `gen:docs`, which was the one artifact it proved stale. At the default 4096 MB heap, `check:test-typecheck` stops with "tsc failed without diagnostics", an out-of-memory error and not a verdict. At 8192 MB it passes: 52 files, 240 errors, all 131 pinned signatures held.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 815 passed (815), Tests 25648 passed, 1 todo. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/service-analytics`: `test` gives Test Files 211 passed (211), Tests 4996 passed, 300 skipped. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `test` gives Test Files 115 passed (115), Tests 1319 passed. `type-check`: exit 0.
- Consumers that `git grep drillRanges` lists: `@object-ui/core` 233 files passed (4376 tests), `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` 202 files passed (1932 tests), `@object-ui/plugin-report` 33 files passed (307 tests).
- eslint on the 10 changed source files: 0 errors (warnings as in Acceptance notes).

<details><summary>Ablation of the serving half (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob bca6a0582f42)</summary>

- Mutation: `result.drillScopes = measureDrillScopes({` became `void measureDrillScopes({` in `analytics-service.ts`. The anchor count went 1 → 0, and the blob went `bca6a0582f42` → `98dc47836851`.
- `dataset-drill-scopes.test.ts`: **17 failed | 3 passed (20)**.
  - Every service pin went red on both tiers, the bucket CONTROL and the contract-vs-wire pin included.
  - The 3 that stayed green are the two direct walk tests and the record-list CONTROL (`engine.find` refuses a dotted key), none of which goes through the service.
- Restore: the blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the service from `src`, so no rebuild was needed.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates: dispatch-gates --commands, 110 derived at ba62840b, 110 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran ran.list` printed "110 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 110 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 110 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)" and exited 0. Every line is `exit 0`.
- On the first pass two gates exited 3 because built output was missing:
  - `check:skill-examples` lacked the `client-react` dist.
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` lacked the dists of account, setup, studio, client-react, cloud-connection, connector-imap and connector-mcp.
  - After `turbo run build` of those 7 packages, both exit 0.
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit `621a4876` fetched into the shallow clone first. The longest runs: `check:type-check-debt` 277 s, `check:query-options-erasure` 201 s, `ui` `vitest run scripts/` 192 s.
- No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so there was no full dogfood run. CI owns the rest of the farm.
</details>
